description: Write ONE frame of the film as a picture file in the working folder's exports/ (PNG, or JPEG): a poster for a thumbnail, a social card, a web page. Give a time in seconds (at) or a shot number (taken once its elements have arrived); without either, the first shot. Look at the frame with still_film first. The plan gates it like export_film (premium pieces, formats).

at.description: A time in seconds from the start of the film

name.description: The film's name in the working folder (see list_films)

shot.description: A shot (1 = first), taken once its elements have arrived

name: export_still
title: Export a poster
